pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Each teaching team (i.e. four or more teachers with a common group of students) shall have a paid team leader... A team leader who is not a lead teacher shall receive a $3000 annual stipend. Lead teachers shall receive stipends above the salary to which they would otherwise be entitled. Curriculum Councils are elected bodies... Each Curriculum Council shall have a chairperson, which shall be a lead teacher position... pool of one hundred (100) days of released time

pd_career_ladder_003.evidence: The Career in Teaching Program shall include five career development levels: Level I Apprentice... Level II Novice... Level III Career... Level IV Advanced... Level V Accomplished... Lead teachers are selected from the advanced and accomplished levels... Lead teachers shall receive stipends above the salary to which they would otherwise be entitled.
